narrative.overview:
Peaksnature sells a feeling the guest already has in mind: mist over a valley, a house with nobody else around, a morning that asks nothing of you. The interface earns trust by getting out of the way. Real photographs of real houses lead; warm ivory and sand surfaces hold them; one deep forest green speaks for every action. Names of places and prices are set in a serif, the way a good guesthouse letters its sign. Everything a guest reads or taps is plain, legible and familiar.

The system is premium but approachable, and conventional on purpose: the owner wants Booking.com-simple structure, done with care, not novel layouts. Ambition shows as restraint and precision. Guest pages are airy; the host dashboard and admin use the same palette and type at a denser, scannable rhythm. Surfaces are flat at rest; depth comes from tonal layers and fine borders, and shadow is reserved for things that float. Motion explains a change or draws a line; it never decorates.

Confirmed rejections (the owner's brief): generic AI-generated SaaS looks, gradients, glassmorphism, unnecessary shadows, excessively rounded cards, black buttons as the default, low-contrast text, decorative motion, and decoration that gets in the way of booking.
keyCharacteristics: Real photography first; the interface recedes.
One voice for action: Forest green, never black, never a gradient.
Warm neutrals only (the earth-* scale); text dark enough to read in daylight.
Serif for place names, headings and prices; system sans for reading and tapping.
Flat at rest; borders and tonal layers for structure; shadow only when floating.
Thai-first: no letter-spacing, no faux italics, no text under 12px.
Phone-first for guests and hosts alike.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Forest is the only colour for primary actions and selection. Never the shadcn default Button (its --primary is near-black #171717), never a gradient, never a second accent for the same job.

rules.name: The Readable Earth Rule
rules.body: Text on light surfaces is earth-600 or darker. earth-300 and earth-400 are lines and decoration; earth-500 is borders and large text.

rules.name: The Photo Scrim Rule
rules.body: Text over a photograph sits on a scrim strong enough to give 4.5:1 against the brightest photo a host might upload, not just the demo photo.

rules.name: The No-Track Thai Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing and uppercase are Latin-only. Tracking pulls Thai vowels and tone marks away from their consonants. Gate it on the locale or script, as src/components/booking/booking-footer.tsx and src/components/full-screen-menu.tsx already do, and as SectionMark does by keeping its tracked numerals Latin.

rules.name: The Upright Thai Rule
rules.body: Never italicise Thai. Noto Serif Thai ships no italic, so the browser fakes a slant. Emphasise with Forest colour or weight.

rules.name: The 12px Floor
rules.body: No text under 12px, Thai or Latin. Thai running text is 14px minimum, 16px in inputs.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons and inputs carry no shadow at rest. shadow-lg/shadow-xl on a CTA or a summary card, and hover lift on a card that is not a link, are drift.

dos: Do use Forest (#2F5D50) for every primary action, selection and focus ring.
Do set text on light surfaces in earth-600 (#75604e) or darker, and in earth-300 or lighter on Charcoal.
Do give every input a visible label tied to it with htmlFor, a 1px earth-500 border and a 2px solid Forest focus ring.
Do keep tap targets at 44 × 44px on phones and never under 24 × 24px.
Do keep tracking and uppercase to Latin text; reuse the locale gate in booking-footer.tsx.
Do keep cards flat: white, 1px Sand border, 18px radius.
Do start content visible. Motion may refine an entrance; it may not hide content until JavaScript runs.
Do wrap every motion tree in RespectReducedMotion, and give every CSS keyframe a prefers-reduced-motion rule.
Do keep UI transitions under 300ms and animate only transform and opacity.
Do show prices with tabular-nums, and "เริ่มต้น" (from) whenever the figure is a minimum.
donts: Don't use the shadcn default Button variant, bg-primary or text-primary: they render near-black (#171717).
Don't set text in earth-400 (2.98:1) or earth-500 (4.33:1) on light surfaces, or in earth-500 on Charcoal (3.03:1).
Don't letter-space or italicise Thai (tracking-*, uppercase, italic on Thai strings).
Don't set text under 12px (text-[9px], text-[10px], text-[11px], text-[0.7rem]).
Don't use gradients (bg-gradient-to-*), glass (.glass-nav, backdrop-blur on bars) or shadow-lg/shadow-xl on cards and buttons.
Don't use rounded-3xl on cards, or nest more than one surface inside a card.
Don't use raw Tailwind greys (gray-*, slate-*) or hard-coded hexes (bg-[#f8f9fa], bg-[#F83858], text-[#111111]); use the earth-* scale.
Don't colour booking statuses per screen; use the StatusBadge tones.
Don't add hover lift to cards that are not links.
Don't use transition-all; name the properties.
Don't invent testimonials, people, numbers or claims (src/components/landing/reviews.tsx is placeholder copy and must never ship).
